procedural_matters: Case 30 was heard together with Case 27 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) as both hearings arose from the same incident.
AUS 28 was represented by Jake LIDDELL.
TUR 7 was represented by Alican KAYNAR.
The Race Committee was represented by Corinne AUBERT.
AUS 28 provided video evidence and wind reading data.
Aloise RETORNAZ (FRA 51) was a witness for AUS 28.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b). Procedural matters regarding validity:
Race 11 started at 14:00 and the last boat finished 14:51.
AUS 28 and TUR 7 tried to lodge their hearing requests online, but could not because of a system error.
AUS 28 and TUR 7 approached the race office and delivered their hearing requests on papers at 16:16, having first informed the Class Manager of the problem at 15:36.
AUS 28 and TUR 7 delivered their requests for redress within two hours after the incident, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1).
facts: Race 11 started at 14:00 with 5 - 7 knots of wind.
During the first downwind leg, the wind dropped to 3 - 4 knots.
At the gate, the Race Committee signalled a change of course, shortening the windward leg from.55 to.49 nautical miles.
Five minutes after the wind dropped, the wind increased again to 5 - 6 knots.
The wind did not cause the fleet to invert.
The time limit for the race was 45 minutes and the finish window was 15 minutes.
The first boat finished at 14:39 and the last boat finished at 14:51.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the Race Committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
